keyFindings.description: The daemon's own GitHub calls for a tree recorded under the old name still mint the App token for the old owner and address the old repository: the merge submission and disarm (auto_merge.go:264-279 graphQL), the required-checks pass (required_checks.go:285-300), the production check's compare and deploy-run read (outbox.go:1517-1526, so the new rename-aware test at :1657 is never reached), branch creation (outbox.go:1830-1843), the implementer completion's pull-request read (api/handoff.go:313-322) and workspace provisioning (outbox.go:1302-1306; sandbox podkind.go:345-357, ghcredential.go:115, repocache.go:355). After the transfer only the cybermonklabs installation covers the repository (the spec's own words), so a tree open at the transfer can never be merged by Legion, against the PR body's 'its merge, with no restart' and the parent's acceptance. Needs one choke point that maps a recorded repository to its served rename partner before any mint or API path, and a test that drives readyMerge for a tree recorded under the old name.

heardRepositories (:1173-1182) overwrites an already-heard repository's GitHub spelling with the pair's spelling. NATS subjects are case-sensitive and the docs say both names are compared without case, so a pair spelled in another case than GitHub's leaves the consumer subscribed to subjects Envoy never publishes for the moved repository. Add a partner only when it is not already heard.

Lookups (:107-112) answers the partner in the pair's configured spelling while the store matches pull_requests.repo exactly (record/store.go:492,506,526), so a pair spelled in another case misses the row recorded under GitHub's spelling. It also allocates a slice on every call, including the zero value every deployment without a rename carries, and its loop is copied at four sites (engine.go:1168,1184, review_permission.go:105, consume.go:673).

With a pair configured, fillRepositories passes :122 and fills repo=<old clone spelling> with github=<new name>, which record.Store.FillIssueRepository refuses (store.go:303); nameRepositories passes :216 and NameIssueRepository refuses (store.go:318). The boot still refuses, now with a raw store error instead of the actionable one, and the new docstring at :50-51 says the opposite.

echo "IMAGE=$(repo-paths.sh worker_image)" (:150) and echo "envoy_image=$(…)" (release-envoy-listener.yaml:120) hide the script's refusal: a failed command substitution inside echo's arguments does not fail a bash -e step, so an empty image name goes on to later steps. Assign first, then echo, as release-envoy-infra.yaml does.

The once-only conflict warning gives the closure a mutex and a map, forces api/server.go to build it once, and still logs twice (one closure in the API server, one in the runtime). The warning belongs at mapping load beside logUnservedRenames; GitHubCredential can then be stateless and lose its log parameter.

repoPathKeys requires all seven keys though the site reads four (docs_site, docs_base, repository_url, docs_edit_base), so renaming an image key in the script breaks the docs build; the doc comment says 'this site reads'.

DeployOf's doc says 'a project names a repository's workflow once (config's readDeploys), so at most one matches', which a rename makes false: readDeploys (config/stage3.go:262-266) refuses only the same name twice, so deploys naming both names of a pair with one workflow both match and the second is silently ignored. Refuse that pair once renames settle, or correct the doc.
